name: promoseven/biometric-protocol
description: Framework-agnostic PHP library for standalone biometric terminals that speak the ZKTeco network protocol. Reads attendance, users, fingerprint templates and cards and drives enrollment over plain UDP/TCP, with no vendor DLL, OCX or SDK runtime.

suggest.ext-sockets: Raises the UDP receive buffer above the 64KB default so a whole attendance table fits. Without it, bulk reads on large tables are markedly more likely to fail with 'Incomplete transfer'.
